rows.meaning: staff on a vessel or machine
rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for staff or workers at a facility and for non-cast workers on a production.

example.english: The airport crew handled my luggage quickly.
example.traditional: 機場啲工作人員好快幫我處理好行李。
example.jyutping: gei1 coeng4 di1 gung1 zok3 jan4 jyun4 hou2 faai3 bong1 ngo5 cyu2 lei5 hou2 haang4 lei5

rows.meaning: staff on a vessel or machine
rows.note: Use this specifically for the crew or an individual crew member of a ship or boat.

example.english: The crew told us to stand on the deck.
example.traditional: 船員叫我哋企喺甲板度。
example.jyutping: syun4 jyun4 giu3 ngo5 dei6 kei5 hai2 gaap3 baan2 dou6

rows.note: Use this for a team of people working together toward a task or goal.

example.english: This crew worked together for three months and finally finished the project.
example.traditional: 呢個團隊一齊做咗三個月，終於完成項目。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 tyun4 deoi6 jat1 cai4 zou6 zo2 saam1 go3 jyut6 zung1 jyu1 jyun4 sing4 hong6 muk6

rows.note: Use this for a close social group of friends, rather than a work team or professional staff.

example.english: I went to Cheung Chau with a crew of friends during the holiday.
example.traditional: 我同一班朋友放假嗰陣去長洲玩。
example.jyutping: ngo5 tung4 jat1 baan1 pang4 jau5 fong3 gaa3 go2 zan6 heoi3 coeng4 zau1 waan2
